Application Data.NAME: Stitch & Style Embroidery
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Stitch & Style Embroidery specializes in creating customized embroidery designs and apparel tailored to meet the unique needs of our clients. We offer a range of services including logo embroidery, personalized gifts, and promotional items, ensuring high-quality production and attention to detail. Our team collaborates closely with customers to provide design consultations and quick turnaround times, making us a preferred choice for businesses and individuals looking for custom apparel solutions.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: In 2022, a sewing machine malfunction caused a fire in our workshop, leading to damages estimated at $3,000. The issue was promptly addressed, and equipment was replaced. The claim status is closed. Additionally, in early 2023, we experienced a theft incident where $2,000 worth of inventory was stolen; this claim is currently pending investigation.
